findings.text: THE SEAL'S RECORD NAMES A RELAY HEAD THAT DOES NOT CARRY EVERY TOOL IT SEALED: the seal hashed the working tree, and a sealed tool edited after its last commit before the seal was hashed uncommitted -- b714_checks.py at b714 (last committed d89d649f, the record's relay head 601dab1f), b713_checks.py and b713_closing.py at b713 (relay head b7503853); the seal's commit is the first to carry the sealed bytes in both. The core reads the sealed tools at the seal's commit (EQUAL) and prints the relay head's reading apart; not copied forward.

b713'S COMPONENTS BANK IS NOT COMPOSED FROM ITS STEP BANK: its composer wrote each component's line as prose naming banks and figures (its tools/b713_record.py components route), with no step row and no commit list; the core composes each line from the step bank's phases (the form b714's stand-in wrote, EQUAL on b714), so every line differs in form. Not copied forward.

forms.text: the combined bank's first figure line carries no WITHHELD clause: b713's combine predates the withheld field (b714's word (7)); the figures EQUAL, the text the old form
